subcategory_text: Contextual factors related to the systems/products/services and the data actions are identified (e.g., individuals’ demographics and privacy interests or perceptions, data sensitivity and/or types, visibility of data processing to individuals and third parties).
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: RA-3 (Risk Assessment), SI-12 (Information Management and Retention)
Aligned with NIST CSF 2.0 ID.RA-01 (asset vulnerabilities identified) and PV.AE-02 (privacy risk context)
implementation_examples: Identify the contextual factors that shape privacy risk for each processing activity: individuals' demographics and privacy interests, data sensitivity and types, visibility of processing to individuals and third parties, and regulatory environment
Document the factors in the DPIA so that downstream likelihood and impact decisions are explicit
Refresh the factors when the data subject community, data set, or processing pattern changes
assessment_objectives: Determine whether contextual factors are identified per processing activity
Determine whether contextual factors are documented and referenced in risk decisions
Determine whether contextual factors are refreshed on relevant change
Determine whether the set of factors covers individual, data, and processing-ecosystem dimensions
related_controls: PV.AE-02 (NIST AI RMF — privacy risk context)
